milestones.name: Obtain Mothwing Cloak
milestones.note: First movement ability likely acquired; dropped by a vessel after defeating Hornet in Greenpath

milestones.name: Defeat Hornet
milestones.note: Required prerequisite before the vessel falls and drops the Mothwing Cloak in Greenpath

zones.name: Forgotten Crossroads
zones.fingerprintHint: Dark blue/purple cavern with stalactite ceiling, spike hazards on ground, floating platforms, and large winged enemy; player has 1249 geo

zones.name: Greenpath
zones.fingerprintHint: Lush teal/green underground forest with tall dark pillar-like stalactites, glowing foliage, and bioluminescent atmosphere; player has 441 geo

abilities.name: Mothwing Cloak
abilities.grants: Dash through the air without losing height; allows passing through small gaps and avoiding environmental hazards; one air dash that refreshes on landing or nail-bouncing off an enemy or spike hazard
abilities.note: Dropped by a vessel that falls after Hornet is defeated in Greenpath. Vengeful Spirit is also referenced as a requirement to access the area.

bosses.name: Hornet
bosses.note: Must be defeated before a vessel drops the Mothwing Cloak

objectives.name: Reach Greenpath
objectives.hopDescription: Travel from Forgotten Crossroads into Greenpath

objectives.name: Acquire Vengeful Spirit
objectives.hopDescription: Obtain Vengeful Spirit spell, needed to progress far enough into Greenpath to reach Hornet

objectives.name: Defeat Hornet
objectives.hopDescription: Fight and defeat Hornet in Greenpath; a vessel will then fall and drop the Mothwing Cloak

objectives.name: Pick up Mothwing Cloak
objectives.hopDescription: Collect the Mothwing Cloak dropped by the fallen vessel after Hornet's defeat

connectors.description: Natural progression route connecting the dark crossroads cavern to the lush green forest area
